subject: Blank pages of the Deducer wiki

messages.author: 1a09129d38549286
messages.subject: Blank pages of the Deducer wiki
parts:
Hi, some strange things happen with the Deducer wiki (http://www.deducer.org). There are pages that do not show any contents when you visit them. E.g.:

http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.Development
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.FactorAnalysis
And other...

But the history tab does not show any deletion after the last changes.
The password that was printed in the "Development" page to edit the wiki does not seem to work either.

Ian: do you know what's the reason?

Best,
Helios

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Blank pages of the Deducer wiki
parts:
Thanks very much for the notice. It looks like an automated PHP upgrade broke the (admittedly older) version of pmwiki used to drive the site. I’ve downgraded now, and everything appears to be back up and running.


Best,
Ian
